Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and for outlining the procurement ask. I see three parallel constraints: PO timing, security SSO/audit confirmation, and a short extra eval cycle after SSO is validated.

Proposal (short form):
- Re-baselined evaluation window: Oct 4–Oct 15 (two weeks).
- Minimal acceptance criteria: latency within your 95th percentile SLAs on a 10k QPS synthetic workload, embeddings parity within spec, and successful end-to-end SSO login + audit log capture for a 72-hour soak.
- Interim access: we can provide limited staging API keys immediately (rate-limited, telemetry on). That should let your SREs start soak tests before the PO clears.
- Credit/compensation: if go-live slips beyond Oct 20 due to Redwood-side operational reasons we will extend the first month of hosted credits by 20% and provide priority SLA onboarding.

I'll attach an updated MAP (small edits) and the draft SSO addendum for procurement/Legal. Can we schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to align owners and dates? If procurement can commit to a PO review meeting on Oct 1 that helps us keep the Oct 4 start.

Action items for you: confirm procurement point of contact and SSO contact.

Best,
